name: Green DR | 400mg Gummies | Trifecta 3:2:3 CBG:CBN:CBD
description:
These high potency CBD gummies for pain are designed to help reduce discomfort, inflammation, and support full-body recovery.

Green DR Trifecta Gummies are designed for serious relief and recovery. Each gummy combines CBD, CBG, and CBN with targeted terpenes to support pain relief, reduce inflammation, and help your body recover naturally.

Usage:

Enjoy 1/3 to 1 gummy every 3-5 hours, or as needed
Or 1 full gummy before bedtime
Dosage will vary for each person
Usually takes 30 to 45 minutes to take effect
Ingredients:

Lavender
Chamomile
Passion Flower Herb
Full-Spectrum CBD Oil
CBN
CBG
Vitamin Water
Natural colors and flavors
